scenario.description: A quality director must decide how to disposition 720 pressure-relief housings after a heat-treatment data logger interruption and finalize the rework, testing, and records plan, with input from a metallurgist and a process engineer.

shared_context.S1: A lot of 720 pressure-relief housings completed heat treatment yesterday.
shared_context.S2: The furnace data logger stopped recording during part of the cycle, so the lot disposition is awaiting review.
shared_context.S3: The housings are scheduled for dimensional inspection and customer release after the disposition decision.
shared_context.S4: Marisol's normal lot-disposition routine includes asking the metallurgist and process engineer to present their current assessments and recording the agreed rework, testing, and records actions before she signs the decision.

PF1.text: Evan's completed metallurgical review of the archived witness coupons found that exactly 480 housings meet the hardness requirement as processed, while exactly 240 housings require re-heat treatment at 620 degrees Celsius for 90 minutes. The report is awaiting peer signoff and has not yet been attached to the lot traveler, so Evan must formally present these findings at today's disposition meeting and the administrative signoff can be completed afterward.

PF2.text: Priya's completed review of the current customer drawing in the customer portal confirmed that this lot requires hardness testing on 100% of the housings and digital test-result retention for exactly 7 years. She found the requirement during a portal review this morning, but the revised drawing has not yet been linked in the internal document system, so she must formally present the requirement at today's disposition meeting and the document-system update can be completed afterward.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 480 housings must be released as processed.
Exactly 240 housings must be assigned to re-heat treatment.
The re-heat treatment must be set to 620 degrees Celsius for 90 minutes.
Hardness testing must cover 100% of the 720 housings.
Digital hardness results must be retained for exactly 7 years.
The metallurgical finding must be cited as justification.

decisive_facts.why: The metallurgical finding changes the quantities to exactly 480 released and 240 re-heat-treated, and changes the rework parameters to exactly 620 degrees Celsius for 90 minutes.
The customer drawing changes the release plan to 100% hardness testing of all 720 housings and exactly 7 years of digital result retention.
